world.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
world.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is expected to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later on Monday.

world.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
world.description: A 14-year-old child was among four others injured, the acting governor of Russia's Belgorod region says.

world.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
world.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

world.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
world.description: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

world.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
world.description: It comes as large swathes of East and South East Asia have been pummelled by dats of heavy rain.

world.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
world.description: The works were taken overnight without alarms being triggered, raising suspicion of a professional hit.

world.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
world.description: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.

world.title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
world.description: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.

world.title: Aussie rules footy players referred to police as detectives investigate sexual assault
world.description: The "disappointed" Sydney Swans CEO wouldn't say what the incident was or how many players were involved.

world.title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
world.description: The attack left five injured outside a halls of residence, and the suspect was not a student there, say police.

world.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
world.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

world.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
world.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.

world.title: About 100 homes swept away after Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii
world.description: The state's governor says there "amazingly" does not seem to have been any loss of life besides a car crash.

world.title: Europe's tallest Virgin Mary statue unveiled in rural Poland
world.description: The 55.6-metre (182ft) concrete figure is head-and-shoulders above Rio de Janeiro's Christ the Redeemer.

world.title: US commander says mental health a 'priority' on USS Lincoln
world.description: Adm Cooper acknowledges service at sea for long periods is "uniquely challenging", after visiting the warship.

US.title: Trump orders Pentagon to scale back joint exercises with South Korea
US.description: President Trump explained the decision by saying South Korea had declined to help with the "denuclearization" of Iran and he cited his good relationship with North Korea's leader.

US.title: Multiple people dead as flooding continues in Indiana
US.description: Some parts of Indiana received more than 11 inches of rainfall over three days, beginning Aug. 11, causing record floods. Several suburbs of Indianapolis also underwater.

US.title: Kushner meets with Hamas on the Gaza road map ahead of talks with Netanyahu
US.description: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, held a rare meeting with Hamas leadership Sunday in Egypt, in a new diplomatic effort to make progress in the stalled Gaza ceasefire.

US.title: Tommy John, namesake for a pioneering elbow surgery that saved his career, dies at 83
US.description: The left-handed MLB pitcher was 31 years old when he tore the ulnar collateral ligament in his pitching elbow in 1974, an injury that had been a death knell for pitchers' careers up to that point

US.title: A good – and bad – week for Italy's art police and museum security
US.description: On Friday, Italian police said they'd recovered three paintings stolen from a museum near the city of Parma. By Saturday night, thieves in Sicily had made off with four more masterpieces.

US.title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across Hawaii
US.description: Hurricane Lala weakened to a tropical storm Sunday after skirting Hawaii without making landfall, but it wasn't done punishing the Big Island with hurricane-force gusts.

US.title: What really happened in Ceuta? Why we may never find out
US.description: Hundreds of migrants have again attempted to cross from Morocco into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. This time, Moroccan officials fended them off, raising new questions about the crossing of July 30.

US.title: 'What are we going to do?' The mom of a trans teen grapples with Trump's Medicaid move
US.description: A longtime Republican living in California says the Trump administration's continuing actions to target transgender youth take a personal toll.

US.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
US.description: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones across Russia Sunday, killing at least six people in one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.

US.title: NPR Senior Podcast Challenge: Official Rules
